A soft, delicious Turkish-style breakfast pan made with eggs, milk, and flour — loaded with colorful bell peppers, sausage (sucuk), and melted cheese. Perfect for busy mornings or a family brunch! 🧡 Quick to prepare, easy to bake, and full of flavor!

📊 Estimated Macros (per bonbon, est. – makes 5):
Calories: ~60 | Fat: ~5 g | Protein: ~2.8 g | Net Carbs: ~1.5 g

Ingredients (Makes 5 bonbons):
⅔ cup full-fat Greek yogurt (150 g)
1 tbsp peanut butter (15 g)
1 tbsp cocoa powder (8 g)
Keto-friendly sweetener, to taste (I used sugar-free maple syrup, about 1–2 tsp / 5–10 ml)
Topping:
Sugar-free dark chocolate, melted (about 1 oz / 30 g)

Instructions:
In a bowl, combine the Greek yogurt, peanut butter, cocoa powder, and sweetener until smooth.
Spoon or shape the mixture into bonbons and place them on a parchment-lined tray.
Freeze for at least 4 hours, until fully firm.
Dip the frozen bonbons into the melted sugar-free dark chocolate.
Return to the freezer or fridge until the chocolate sets, then enjoy! 🫶🏼
